operations.name: couplings.import
operations.summary: Replace the couplings with a CSV's, under a label mapping the caller confirmed (stable IDs kept).

operations.name: couplings.reconcile
operations.summary: Read a couplings CSV against the project: the proposed label mapping and the diff (no change).

operations.name: fit.preview
operations.summary: Preview the fit at a fixed torsion: order parameters re-solved, predictions and residuals.

operations.name: fit.run
operations.summary: Fit the project's model (D3): estimates, validity, adequacy, and optional profile intervals under the reporting policy.

operations.name: model.set
operations.summary: Set the model: kind (rigid, jump4), order model, frame and torsion domain.

operations.name: molecule.set_torsion
operations.summary: Declare the fitted torsion of imported geometry: four atom indices (a, i, j, b), i–j a bond.

operations.name: project.describe
operations.summary: Describe the project: geometry, spins, couplings, model, estimand and readiness to fit, with IDs.

operations.name: project.export
operations.summary: The project as *.dipolar.json text, with a suggested file name.

operations.name: project.import_xyz
operations.summary: Replace the project with one on imported XYZ coordinates (one spin per hydrogen, no couplings).

operations.name: project.load
operations.summary: Replace the project with a *.dipolar.json document (validated and migrated).

operations.name: project.open_example
operations.summary: Replace the session's project with a bundled example dataset.

operations.name: render.describe_view
operations.summary: Describe the shared view: revisions and the current selection, with labels.

operations.name: view.select
operations.revision_check: none: an absolute set; IDs are validated atomically and never reused
operations.summary: Set the shared selection to the given spin or coupling IDs (replaces it).
